question: Simplify: (9x² - 4y²)/(9x - 2y) times (3x)/(9x + 2y)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assuming the intended numerator is (9x)² − (2y)² = 81x² − 4y² to correctly match the answer options.

⇒ Corrected expression: [ (9x − 2y)(9x + 2y) / (9x − 2y) ] × [ 3x / (9x + 2y) ]

⇒ Cancel (9x − 2y) and (9x + 2y) from the numerator and denominator.

⇒ Remaining value = 3x

**∴ The correct answer is 3x.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = (9x² − 4y²) / (9x − 2y) × 3x / (9x + 2y)

*Note: There is a typographical error in the original question. For the expression to simplify to the correct option, the numerator should be 81x² − 4y².*

Corrected Expression = [ (81x² − 4y²) / (9x − 2y) ] × [ 3x / (9x + 2y) ]

**Formula Used:**

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Apply the difference of squares formula to the corrected numerator.

⇒ 81x² − 4y² = (9x)² − (2y)² = (9x − 2y)(9x + 2y)

⇒ Substitute this back into the corrected expression:

⇒ = [ (9x − 2y)(9x + 2y) / (9x − 2y) ] × [ 3x / (9x + 2y) ]

⇒ Cancel out the common term (9x − 2y) from the first fraction:

⇒ = (9x + 2y) × [ 3x / (9x + 2y) ]

⇒ Cancel out the common term (9x + 2y):

⇒ = 3x

**∴ The correct answer is 3x.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares Identity

The formula a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b) is one of the most frequently used algebraic identities for factorisation and simplification.

Perfect Square Trinomials

a² + 2ab + b² = (a + b)² and a² − 2ab + b² = (a − b)². These are essential for expanding and simplifying complex algebraic expressions.

Sum and Difference of Cubes

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) and a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²).
